appName.message: What about the dollar? - Live US dollar exchange rates in Argentina

appDesc.message: Official, blue, MEP, CCL and crypto dollar rates on your toolbar. Daily change, converter and alerts when it crosses your price.

error_general_title.message: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

error_general_description.message: If the problem persists, feel free to get in touch.

label_badge_exchange_rate_desc.message: Shows a badge on the extension icon with the live price of the exchange rate you pick.

label_badge_buy_sell_desc.message: Choose whether the badge shows the buying or the selling price.

label_badge_color_desc.message: Lets you choose the background colour of the badge.

label_badge_color_title.message: Pick the background colour for the badge.

label_tooltip_exchange_rate_desc.message: Hovering the extension icon shows the buying and selling price of the rate you pick, along with when it was last updated.

label_hide_conversor_desc.message: Toggles the visibility of the converter.

label_default_tab_desc.message: Pick the tab the extension opens on.

legal_terms_text.message:
This extension provides real-time information about the US dollar exchange rate in Argentina, for informational purposes only. The values shown come from dolarapi.com, the source of the rates, and from argentinadatos.com, the source of the daily closing history used to work out the day’s change. They must not be taken as financial, investment or any other kind of advice. The extension is not responsible for the accuracy or availability of the data, nor for any change to it. Use of this extension is at the user’s own risk, and the data presented is no substitute for professional advice.

Users are responsible for verifying the accuracy of the values shown and for making decisions based on their own judgement and professional advice. We accept no liability for any damage or loss arising from the use of this extension.

This extension respects and protects its users’ privacy. We do not collect personal information, we use no analytics or trackers, and nothing is loaded from third parties. The requests to dolarapi.com and argentinadatos.com are read-only and send no information about the user. There is no server of our own.

Data related to the use of the extension (the chosen settings and a copy of the latest rates and history) is stored locally in your browser through the Chrome storage API. The settings also sync across the browsers where you are signed in to Chrome: that is done by Chrome through your own Google account. That information is never shared with third parties nor used for anything outside the extension’s functionality.

The price alert is off by default. If you turn it on, the comparison happens entirely inside your browser against the value you entered, and the notification only ever contains the name of the rate and the price.

When you use the right-click converter, the text you selected reaches the extension only at that moment and only because you asked for it: it is used to work out the result and then discarded. It is never stored or transmitted. The extension injects no code into the pages you visit and requests no permissions over them, so it cannot read their content.

If at any point we decide to change our privacy policy, we will notify users through an update to the extension. By using this extension you accept the terms of this privacy policy.

label_other_currencies_desc.message: Adds the euro, the Brazilian real, the Chilean peso and the Uruguayan peso to the table, so you can check and convert them just like the dollar.

label_alert_enabled_desc.message: Shows a notification when the selling price of the chosen rate crosses the value you set. It is checked every time the extension refreshes, and alerts once per crossing.

label_alert_rate_desc.message: The rate being watched. It is always compared against the selling price.

label_alert_value_desc.message: Choose whether to be alerted when the price goes above that value or when it falls below it.

alert_message_above.message: $var1$ is at $var2$, above the $var3$ you set.

alert_message_below.message: $var1$ is at $var2$, below the $var3$ you set.
